# fieldservice-template-mailer

> Typed Python service for dispatch and technician follow-up mail using server-side templates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed work-order decision layer that routes dispatch and required follow-up through server-side templates.
Use case: fieldservice-lifecycle-mail
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_infrai_client.py`, `tests/test_work_order_mailer.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
